```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from "fs";
import { STREAM_PLUGIN_IDS } from "@/json-render/catalog/stream-plugins";

describe("stream plugins sync", () => {
  const manifestPath = "/dev/shm/opdbus/plugin-blobs/.manifest.json";

  it.skipIf(!existsSync(manifestPath))("every sealed plugin is in STREAM_PLUGIN_IDS", () => {

    const missing = sealedPlugins.filter((id) => !STREAM_PLUGIN_IDS.includes(id as any));
    expect(missing, `Missing from STREAM_PLUGIN_IDS: ${missing.join(", ")}`).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```
